lessons_used: Predictions were generally overly optimistic, but underestimated gains for winning tests in sign-in reorders, home notifications, adoption new flows, and choose path layouts.

Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder), home notifications (home, notification), adoption new flows (adoption, new_flow), and choose path layouts (choose_path, layout) proved helpful across multiple winning tests.

Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), finish hints (finish, hint), finish incentives (finish, incentive), home hints (home, hint), and sign-in notifications (sign_in, notification) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) and finish redesigns (finish, redesign) resulted in negative impacts or guardrail rollbacks across multiple tests.

Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once (including adoption incentive, adoption wait_info, choose_path hint/incentive/new_flow, home new_flow, and sign_in new_flow), requiring at least 2 tests to state a pattern.

candidates.title: Choose Path Interactive Choice Flow
candidates.change: Replace path option cards with an interactive preview flow that displays animated companion behavior previews for each path option.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s despite 78.5% conversion, showing user hesitation; past lessons highlight choose path layout/flow changes as effective.

guard.reason: Redesigning choose path with interactive previews is allowed under Rule 4 and retains path selection.

candidates.score_note: Choose path interactive flow needs new screens and single previous test showed negative lift (-1.4%).

candidates.title: Sign In Spotlight Layout Refresh
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen using a spotlight layout to focus attention on quick authentication actions.
candidates.why: Sign-in mean duration is 567s and support reported sign-in stalls; layout improvements help focus user attention.

guard.reason: Redesigning sign in layout is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in stalls reported in support and funnel; layout redesign has moderate confidence.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Two Column Layout
candidates.change: Rebuild the pet selection screen into a two-column layout comparing pet appearance and pet personality traits side-by-side.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 75.7% with mean duration of 1017s; side-by-side evaluation streamlines selection.

guard.reason: Rebuilding pick friend into a two-column layout is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off (75.7%) and duration; layout changes show mixed past results.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Desktop Notification Alert
candidates.change: Display a system notification toggle and confirmation banner on the waiting screen to alert users on desktop when pet setup finishes.
candidates.why: Home step mean time is 2336s as users leave the app during generation; home notifications were highlighted as a winning pattern in past lessons.

components.text: We will alert you on desktop when ready

guard.reason: Adding a notification alert component to the waiting screen is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Home notifications are a proven winning pattern with low implementation cost.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Story Scroll Layout
candidates.change: Reorganize the adoption certificate screen into a story scroll layout that guides users through adoption summary details.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops conversion to 75.7%; clear layout structure during adoption confirmation helps push users forward.

guard.reason: Reorganizing adoption certificate layout is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adoption drop-off is high, but layout scroll change has average expected impact.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Interactive Animation Flow
candidates.change: Introduce an interactive animation flow on the pet selection screen allowing users to trigger live animations of pet reactions.
candidates.why: Adoption has high friction (1017s mean time); past lessons noted adoption new flows as strong performers.

guard.reason: Adding interactive reaction animations to pet selection is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adoption new flows highlighted as winning pattern despite higher build cost.

candidates.title: New Pet Trait Preview Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated companion trait preview screen before custom photo upload to show how traits will be mapped onto the pet.
candidates.why: Support mails reported custom pet failures and incorrect rendering (3 emails); clarifying pet traits beforehand sets proper expectations.

new_trait_preview.headline: Companion Trait Preview
new_trait_preview.body: See how your desktop pet will act and interact on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding a new trait preview screen inside onboarding is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Strong support email evidence, but introducing new screens consistently caused negative impact in past tests.

candidates.title: Upload Photos Checklist Layout
candidates.change: Update photo upload layout to a checklist structure outlining recommended photo lighting, angle, and clarity steps.
candidates.why: Support received 3 complaints regarding failed or misbehaved custom pets; structured checklist format improves upload quality.

guard.reason: Updating photo upload layout to a checklist structure is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Supported by 3 user complaint emails and high adoption drop-off; low cost layout adjustment.

candidates.title: Story Screen Card Layout Refresh
candidates.change: Refresh the initial story intro screen using a clean card layout highlighting core pet interaction features.
candidates.why: Choose path mean duration is 514s; choose path layout changes have consistently proven successful in past iterations.

guard.reason: Refreshing story screen layout is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Choose path layout changes highlighted as consistent winning pattern across multiple tests.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Live Progress Flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive stage progress component to the waiting screen that updates dynamically as desktop assets initialize.
candidates.why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s; visual stage progress keeps users informed while the app generates pet assets.

guard.reason: Adding dynamic progress bar to waiting screen is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high waiting duration (2336s); previous single test showed +2.5% lift but evidence remains thin.
